protocol.event_case: March 2026, already known; development case, not blind validation
protocol.revision_reason: 2024-only reference failed spring coverage; extend reference using H1 2025, calibrate on H2 2025, retain algorithm unchanged. H2 2025 is now calibration, not an independent test
protocol.preference: Favor inspection sensitivity over fewer false alarms; shared and relative loss scored separately
protocol.controls: 5% and 10% residual-only loss on each calibrated target for 21 days from first of each April-September 2026 month; predeclared before revised-model evaluation; background labels unknown

final_pattern.interpretation: Shared loss is compatible with soiling; relative loss is compatible with a local fault. Neither pattern uniquely identifies the cause.
